triage.fix_rationale: The limits are the lobby-wait timeout constants in the specs and the Playwright global test timeout. Raising them, or sharing one longer lobby wait, fixes it.
triage.hypothesis: The aubade lobby did not finish loading within the fixed wait (20s lobby timeout inside a 30s test timeout) on the CPU-rasterised runner, so every test waiting for "Unlocking the lobby" to disappear timed out. The branch only bumps Python dev dependencies, so the frontend did not change; the lazy chunk, shader compile and software raymarch are slower than the time budget.
